longTasks.limits: Same-browser-document intervals start at trusted input/first scripted pointer dispatch and end at second rAF; they exclude automation waits before dispatch and are not full Node spans, physical paint, React commit or CPU ownership attribution. Rows drained after a round can precede measurement; drain window does not assign causality.

browserResourceTiming.scope: All retained browser resource entries, including setup/quiet/drain; not exact CDP request joins or backend function timings. Do not subtract from Node timestamps or infer body completion while held.

limits: One controlled run of exact product990/helpera31; not current67a5 performance acceptance.
All200 held responses naturally cancelled; no held response later delivered its body. This is response availability/backpressure plus cancellation, not isolated frontend commit deferral.
Both project-switch p95 values exceed unchanged300ms. Inputs satisfy the100ms reference only under intervention; no overall latency pass.
Repeated actions share one fixture/browser; small tails and block/project summaries are descriptive. No optimization or frontend-only cause justified.
No model/provider/worker runs; explicit setup writes outside measured interval remain in original evidence.
Independent closure proves only exact driver/controller absence and empty exclusive Docker/volume inventory; no independent browser PID census or whole-machine closure.
